episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overviewEn: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر مورننغستار يترك العالم السفلي ويستقر في لوس أنجلوس بحثاً عن حياة أكثر إثارة. وحين تُقتل مغنية يعرفها أمام ناديه، يتعاون مع المحققة كلوي ديكر للوصول إلى القاتل.

episodes.name: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
episodes.overviewEn: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel continue to encourage Lucifer to go back to hell.
episodes.overviewAr: ابن نجم سينمائي يُقتل بعد مطاردة من مصوّري المشاهير، وكلوي تتعمق في القضية، ولوسيفر يصرّ على مرافقتها.

episodes.name: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
episodes.overviewEn: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help. Lucifer enlists Chloe to investigate the case, which leads to the world of big money sports and people who will literally kill to be number one.
episodes.overviewAr: لاعب كرة قدم شاب ينتظره مستقبل لامع يستيقظ ليجد فتاة ميتة في مسبحه، ويطلب مساعدة لوسيفر.

episodes.name: Manly Whatnots
episodes.overviewEn: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يحاول فهم سبب مناعة كلوي ضد تأثيره، وهما يحققان في اختفاء فتاة حضرت ندوة لمدرّب «علاقات».

episodes.name: Sweet Kicks
episodes.overviewEn: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer becomes intrigued by the danger of the situation and begs Chloe to get in on the case. Meanwhile, when Maze admits to Amenadiel that she wants to go back to hell, he sets his sights on Dr. Linda.
episodes.overviewAr: إطلاق نار في عرض أزياء يودي بحياة شابة، ولوسيفر يجد في خطر القضية ما يثير اهتمامه.

episodes.name: Favorite Son
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder. However, when he discovers something was stolen during the crime that was very personal to him, he demands that Chloe let him rejoin the case.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يملّ تحقيق كلوي في جريمة لعصابة درّاجات، ثم ينقلب موقفه حين يعرف ما سُرق منه.

episodes.name: Wingman
episodes.overviewEn: In attempt to find the contents of his stolen container, Lucifer enlists the help of an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.
episodes.overviewAr: في بحثه عن محتويات حاويته المسروقة، يستعين لوسيفر بحليف غير متوقع: أخوه أمينادييل.

episodes.name: Et Tu, Doctor?
episodes.overviewEn: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects. Meanwhile, Malcolm confronts Chloe about the night he was shot, and Lucifer experiences his first bout of jealousy.
episodes.overviewAr: معالج نفسي يُقتل، ولوسيفر وكلوي يستعينان بالدكتورة ليندا لفحص المشتبه بهم من مرضاه.

episodes.name: A Priest Walks Into a Bar
episodes.overviewEn: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center. Meanwhile, Malcolm manipulates a way to keep an eye on Dan.
episodes.overviewAr: قسّ يطلب مساعدة لوسيفر حين يشك في أن تجارة مخدرات تتخذ من مركز للشباب غطاء لها.

episodes.name: Pops
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death. Meanwhile, Chloe's mom returns home, sending Chloe's life into upheaval, as Lucifer learns his own dysfunctional family isn't nearly as unique as he thought.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يحققان في مقتل صاحب مطاعم معروف، وعلاقته المتوترة بابنه تمسّ وتراً عند لوسيفر.

episodes.name: St. Lucifer
episodes.overviewEn: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim’s glitzy Los Angeles charity.
episodes.overviewAr: رجل خير معروف يُعثر عليه ميتاً، ولوسيفر يجرّب جانبه الطيب بأن يصير متبرعاً لجمعيته.

episodes.name: #TeamLucifer
episodes.overviewEn: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame - with her body  twisted into the shape of a pentagram - the investigation leads Lucifer  and team into the world of Satanists, where they soon realize, evil  doesn't always live where we expect it to.
episodes.overviewAr: امرأة تُقتل في جادّة المشاهير بطريقة توحي بطقوس، والشبهات تحوم حول معجبين مهووسين بلوسيفر.

episodes.name: Take Me Back to Hell
episodes.overviewEn: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يُتَّهم زوراً بالقتل، وعليه وعلى كلوي العمل معاً لتبرئته وكشف الفاعل. ختام الموسم الأول.

episodes.name: Everything's Coming Up Lucifer
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer is distracted by his mother’s escape from hell, as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress. Meanwhile, Chloe’s faith in Lucifer is tested by the new medical examiner, Ella. Also, Amenadiel hopes to rein in Lucifer’s wild side, as they both deal with the absence of Maze.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر مشغول بهروب أمه من العالم السفلي، وهو وكلوي يحققان في مقتل ممثلة بديلة.

episodes.name: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
episodes.overviewEn: When Lucifer’s mother, Charlotte, turns up at the scene of a grizzly murder pleading innocence, Lucifer is hesitant to believe her tale. Not wanting to leave her on her own, he instructs Maze to babysit her – and not to torture her, allowing him to investigate the case with Chloe.
episodes.overviewAr: أم لوسيفر تظهر في هيئة المحامية شارلوت في مسرح جريمة بشعة وتقول إنها بريئة، ولوسيفر يحقق.

episodes.name: Sin-Eater
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a gruesome murder after a video of the crime surfaces on social media. When a second video appears, they realize they have a serial killer on their hands. Meanwhile, Lucifer’s mom returns as Charlotte Richards. Also, Amenadiel, struggling with his loss of power, has an appointment with Linda.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يحققان في جريمة مروّعة بعد انتشار مقطع مصوّر لها على وسائل التواصل.

episodes.name: Lady Parts
episodes.overviewEn: After the bodies of two young L.A. transplants are found poisoned, Chloe and Lucifer hunt for the killer. Upon Maze convincing Chloe to go out for drinks, which the detective perceives as an act of friendship, but is actually part of a bet between Maze and Lucifer, the two make a shocking decision.
episodes.overviewAr: شابتان انتقلتا حديثاً إلى لوس أنجلوس تُعثر عليهما مسمومتين، وكلوي ولوسيفر يطاردان القاتل.

episodes.name: Weaponizer
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer is excited to investigate the murder of his favorite action movie hero, Wesley Cabot. Longtime rival Rolf Van Zandt initially is a suspect, but the investigation soon shifts. Meanwhile, Uriel shows up and Amenadiel is forced to come clean about his lost powers. Also, Lucifer and Uriel fight about Chloe and their mother.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر متحمس للتحقيق في مقتل بطل أفلام الحركة المفضل عنده. وأخوه أوريل يصل بإنذار.

episodes.name: Monster
episodes.overviewEn: Guilty and self-destructive, Lucifer clashes with Chloe during an investigation, leading her to team up with Dan instead. Meanwhile, Amenadiel bonds with Charlotte, and Maze takes Trixie trick-or-treating.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر المثقل بالذنب يتصرف بتدمير ذاتي ويصطدم بكلوي أثناء تحقيق، فتعمل مع غيره.

episodes.name: My Little Monkey
episodes.overviewEn: When the prisoner convicted of killing Chloe's father is murdered, new evidence suggests he was actually framed. Meanwhile, Maze tries to find a job and Lucifer shadows Dan in order to learn how to be "normal".
episodes.overviewAr: السجين المدان بقتل والد كلوي يُقتل، وأدلة جديدة توحي بأنه كان بريئاً.

episodes.name: Trip to Stabby Town
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer links Azrael's stolen blade to a string of violent stabbings and enlists Ella's help in locating the sword.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يربط نصلاً مسروقاً خطيراً بسلسلة طعنات عنيفة، ويستعين بإيلا لتحديد مكانه.

episodes.name: Homewrecker
episodes.overviewEn: Following the murder of the owner of the building in which Lux is located, Lucifer and Chloe search for the killer, while Lucifer also deals with the fact that the new owner wants to evict him and demolish the place. Lucifer goes to great lengths to protect his home, and is entirely shocked when Chloe is supportive of him. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel follow Charlotte around, as she comes up with a plan to upset Lucifer enough to want to leave earth and go back to Heaven.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد مقتل مالك المبنى الذي يقع فيه ناديه، يبحث لوسيفر وكلوي عن القاتل، والنادي مهدد بالإخلاء.

episodes.name: Quid Pro Ho
episodes.overviewEn: Charlotte is determined to get Lucifer to leave Earth by turning Chloe against him. Meanwhile, Amenadiel has begun working as Charlotte's soldier, which makes Maze question his loyalty.
episodes.overviewAr: شارلوت مصمّمة على دفع لوسيفر إلى مغادرة الأرض بتأليب كلوي عليه.

episodes.name: Stewardess Interruptus
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe investigate the murder of two victims, who happen to be Lucifer's ex-flames.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يحققان في مقتل ضحيتين، كلتاهما من صديقات لوسيفر السابقات.

episodes.name: Love Handles
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a mysterious masked killer who is poisoning college students.
episodes.overviewAr: قاتل مقنّع غامض يسمّم طلاباً جامعيين ويفرض على ضحاياه اختيارات قاسية.

episodes.name: A Good Day to Die
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer must find the antidote to the Professor's poison before it kills Chloe. He travels to hell to find the Professor's soul and get him to turn over the antidote. While he's there, he is forced to confront his guilt about Uriel's death. Mom heads to hell to get Lucifer back, but Lucifer still feels betrayed by his parents because of something he discovers.
episodes.overviewAr: على لوسيفر إيجاد ترياق السمّ قبل أن يقتل كلوي، ولو كلّفه ذلك رحلة إلى العالم السفلي.

episodes.name: Candy Morningstar
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer returns to the city with a new bride in tow, oblivious to the distress his absence has caused. Determined to restore his working relationship with Chloe, he inserts himself into the investigation of the murder of an up-and-coming band's lead singer.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يعود إلى المدينة ومعه عروس جديدة، غير مدرك لما سبّبه غيابه من ألم.

episodes.name: Deceptive Little Parasite
episodes.overviewEn: When it is discovered that the flaming sword is the only hope for the family returning home safely, the pressure is on for Lucifer to control what he has never been able to control before – his emotions – in order to ignite it. Meanwhile, Chloe wants to air some emotions of her own, but when a therapist and head of admissions at a prestigious private school turns up dead, the team must get to the bottom of it.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وأمه يبحثان عن القطع اللازمة لعودة العائلة، وجريمة قتل في مدرسة خاصة تشغله مع كلوي.

episodes.name: God Johnson
episodes.overviewEn: When a grisly murder takes place at an insane asylum, the prime suspect calls himself God. After realizing that this man could actually be his father, Lucifer struggles with his feelings towards him and tries to find the truth, all while trying to discover who the real killer is.
episodes.overviewAr: جريمة قتل بشعة في مصحّة نفسية، والمشتبه به الأول نزيل له ادعاء غريب يربك لوسيفر.

episodes.name: Sympathy for the Goddess
episodes.overviewEn: When the man who had the final piece of the Flaming Sword is murdered and the piece goes missing, Mom joins Chloe and Lucifer on the case to track down the killer. But when Lucifer gets sidelined, Maze recruits him to help save Dr. Linda's endangered career and confronts him about the secrets he's been keeping.
episodes.overviewAr: الرجل الذي كان يحمل القطعة الأخيرة يُقتل والقطعة تختفي، وأم لوسيفر تتورط في التحقيق.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad and the Crispy
episodes.overviewEn: After Charlotte accidentally charbroils a man to death in self-defense, Lucifer must try and keep Chloe from figuring out the truth. Lucifer puts Maze in charge of finding Charlotte and Amenadiel, who have both gone missing in light of recent circumstances, while he finds a permanent solution for the ticking-time-bomb he calls Mom.
episodes.overviewAr: شارلوت تقتل رجلاً بالخطأ دفاعاً عن نفسها، وعلى لوسيفر إبعاد كلوي عن حقيقتها. ختام الموسم الثاني.

episodes.name: They're Back, Aren't They?
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer enlists Chloe's help to determine why he woke up in the desert with his wings on his back again, which could be related to an active crime scene.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يستعين بكلوي ليعرف لماذا استيقظ في الصحراء وقد عاد إليه ما تخلّص منه.

episodes.name: The One with the Baby Carrot
episodes.overviewEn: After Lucifer removes his wings yet again, Linda becomes concerned that he is too focused on tracking down the Sinnerman and neglecting his own well-being. Tensions continue to rise between Lucifer and Chloe, but they realize they must put their differences aside to solve a case in which Lucifer takes a sudden interest. Once Detective Pierce's past is revealed though, everyone realizes that the Sinnerman is much more dangerous than they thought.
episodes.overviewAr: ليندا قلقة من انشغال لوسيفر المفرط بتعقّب «سينرمان»، وهو يحقق مع كلوي في مقتل كوميدي.

episodes.name: Mr. and Mrs. Mazikeen Smith
episodes.overviewEn: After talking to Lucifer and Linda, Maze realizes that she is looking for more out of life and decides to head to Canada for a tricky case. Chloe however, becomes concerned when she feels that Maze is being deceived by a scheming conman. Upon further investigation, Lucifer and Chloe make a stunning realization when they find that their target may be much closer than they thought.
episodes.overviewAr: ميز تدرك أنها تريد من الحياة أكثر، فتخرج في مطاردة صيد جوائز إلى كندا.

episodes.name: What Would Lucifer Do?
episodes.overviewEn: When a youth counselor is found murdered, Lucifer and Chloe venture into the world of high-end reform programs to find the killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel adjusts his lifestyle in an attempt to help Lucifer, and Chloe questions Lt. Pierce's feelings towards her.
episodes.overviewAr: مرشد شباب يُعثر عليه مقتولاً، ولوسيفر وكلوي يدخلان عالم مدارس الإصلاح الراقية.

episodes.name: Welcome Back, Charlotte Richards
episodes.overviewEn: When a food chemist is found dead, Lucifer and Chloe's investigation pits them against an unexpected face - criminal defense attorney Charlotte Richards. Everyone is caught off guard when they see her back in the precinct. As Lucifer tries to understand her return, he makes a shocking discovery that helps solve the case.
episodes.overviewAr: خبير أغذية يُعثر عليه ميتاً، والتحقيق يضع لوسيفر وكلوي أمام خصم غير متوقع: شارلوت ريتشاردز العائدة.

episodes.name: Vegas with Some Radish
episodes.overviewEn: When Lucifer discovers Candy has gone missing, he hightails it to Las Vegas with Ella in tow. They work to find her, but interesting secrets could compromise the investigation. Meanwhile, Chloe is upset that Lucifer left on her birthday.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يكتشف أن كاندي مفقودة فيسرع إلى لاس فيغاس ومعه إيلا.

episodes.name: Off the Record
episodes.overviewEn: A reporter seeks revenge when he discovers Lucifer has been sleeping with his estranged wife; a serial killer from Lucifer's past resurfaces.
episodes.overviewAr: صحفي يسعى للانتقام حين يكتشف علاقة لوسيفر بزوجته، ونرى الأحداث من وجهة نظره.

episodes.name: Chloe Does Lucifer
episodes.overviewEn: When a murder is connected to a celebrity dating app, Lucifer and Chloe question all they know about the world of social media in order to solve the case. Meanwhile, Ella tries to avoid Charlotte, and Amenadiel helps Linda deal with the death of her ex-husband.
episodes.overviewAr: جريمة قتل مرتبطة بتطبيق تعارف للمشاهير، وكلوي تتنكر لتدخل عالمه.

episodes.name: The Sinnerman
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer is worried when he realizes that recipients of his favors start to turn up dead. After he and Chloe investigate, they are finally brought face-to-face with the Sinnerman. Meanwhile, Detective Pierce returns to work after taking a bullet, Charlotte finds a new career and Amenadiel has a new love interest.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يقلق حين يبدأ من أسدى إليهم خدمات بالموت واحداً بعد آخر.

episodes.name: The Sin Bin
episodes.overviewEn: With the Sinnerman in custody, Lucifer is prepared to go to any length to get his devil face back. Meanwhile, Trixie is introduced to Charlotte and questions the relationship she has with her father.
episodes.overviewAr: سينرمان في الحجز، ولوسيفر مستعد لأي شيء ليستعيد ما فقده.

episodes.name: City of Angels?
episodes.overviewEn: In a flashback episode that takes place when Lucifer first came to LA, Amenadiel comes to retrieve his fallen brother, but is shocked when he is mugged. Amenadiel enlists Lucifer's help to track down the mugger and Lucifer, in turn, offers his assistance - but only in exchange for a favor. Meanwhile, Chloe and Dan - who are still married - investigate the murder of an MMA fighter, Aidan Scott, at the hands of the same killer who mugged Amenadiel.
episodes.overviewAr: عودة إلى الأيام الأولى للوسيفر في لوس أنجلوس، حين جاء أمينادييل ليعيده.

episodes.name: All About Her
episodes.overviewEn: After Lt. Pierce's true identity is revealed, Lucifer tries to figure out his motives. In order to earn Chloe's assistance in his investigation of Pierce, Lucifer goes above and beyond to help her solve the murder of a professional surfer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel deals with a personal health issue.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد انكشاف الهوية الحقيقية للملازم بيرس، يحاول لوسيفر فهم دوافعه.

episodes.name: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.overviewEn: When an ecstasy cook-turned-chemistry-teacher is found murdered in a cozy Los Angeles suburb, Lucifer and Pierce must go undercover to help track down the killer. Meanwhile, Maze has a newfound attraction for someone that she used to despise and Charlotte has a revelation.
episodes.overviewAr: معلّم كيمياء له ماضٍ في صنع المخدرات يُقتل في ضاحية هادئة، ولوسيفر وبيرس يتنكران كزوجين جارين.

episodes.name: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.overviewEn: When Chloe and Lucifer's investigation into the murder of a diamond thief points to one of Ella's brothers as the main suspect, Ella is driven to prove her brother's innocence and recruits an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Linda is upset when Charlotte comes to her for help and Detective Pierce hashes out his issues with Amenadiel.
episodes.overviewAr: التحقيق في مقتل لص ألماس يشير إلى أحد إخوة إيلا.

episodes.name: High School Poppycock
episodes.overviewEn: When a best-selling novelist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe discover that her books are based on real people from her past, and must infiltrate her high school reunion in order to catch her killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel and Linda struggle with making their relationship public.
episodes.overviewAr: روائية ذات كتب رائجة تُقتل، ويكتشف لوسيفر وكلوي أن رواياتها مبنية على زملاء دراستها الحقيقيين.

episodes.name: Infernal Guinea Pig
episodes.overviewEn: When a murder investigation reveals the dark side of Hollywood, Chloe puts her life on the line to protect an innocent victim. Then, Lucifer comes up with a hell-raising scheme to help Cain, but when Amenadiel and Maze get involved, things don't quite go as planned.
episodes.overviewAr: تحقيق في جريمة قتل يكشف الجانب المظلم من هوليوود، وكلوي تعرّض حياتها للخطر لحماية شاهدة.

episodes.name: Let Pinhead Sing!
episodes.overviewEn: When a superstar singer's life is threatened, the team is thrust into the world of big-ticket stadium shows, crazed fans and divas, giving Lucifer a run for his money. Meanwhile, Charlotte tries to help Linda and Maze repair their friendship.
episodes.overviewAr: حياة مغنية مشهورة مهددة، والفريق يدخل عالم الحفلات الكبرى.

episodes.name: The Last Heartbreak
episodes.overviewEn: As Chloe and Lucifer go on the hunt for a serial killer targeting couples in love, Pierce realizes the case is connected to a murder he previously solved...in 1958. Then, Lucifer becomes upset when Pierce has a change of heart about an important decision.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي ولوسيفر يطاردان قاتلاً متسلسلاً يستهدف الأزواج المتحابين، وبيرس يدرك أن القضية تشبه قضية قديمة.

episodes.name: Orange Is the New Maze
episodes.overviewEn: When Maze is the prime suspect in a murder, Lucifer and Chloe enter the world of bounty hunting to investigate. Maze decides she wants to go back to Hell, but after Lucifer refuses, she turns to Pierce for help. Meanwhile, Charlotte's sanity is questioned when she makes a big discovery and Chloe admits she's dating someone.
episodes.overviewAr: ميز المشتبه بها الأولى في جريمة قتل، ولوسيفر وكلوي يدخلان عالم صيد الجوائز لتبرئتها.

episodes.name: The Angel of San Bernardino
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a murder during which a witness claims a winged guardian angel saved her life, causing Lucifer to become paranoid about his own actions. Meanwhile, Pierce and Chloe's relationship takes an interesting turn and Lucifer discovers something that could change everything.
episodes.overviewAr: شاهدة على جريمة قتل تقول إن ملاكاً مجنّحاً أنقذها، ولوسيفر يخشى أن يكون هو الفاعل في نومه.

episodes.name: Anything Pierce Can Do I Can Do Better
episodes.overviewEn: When a prima ballerina is brutally murdered, Lucifer helps Chloe solve the case and attempts to keep her focus away from Pierce. Amenadiel begs Charlotte to help him with an important plan, and Maze remains devoted to a task from which Pierce asked her to back away. Then, Chloe confronts Lucifer about his meddling in her life, but as he's about to make a huge confession, he finds out something that changes everything.
episodes.overviewAr: راقصة باليه أولى تُقتل بوحشية، ولوسيفر يساعد كلوي في القضية ويحاول إبعادها عن بيرس.

episodes.name: All Hands on Decker
episodes.overviewEn: When Chloe takes some time off, Lucifer is forced to work with Dan on a murder case involving a dog show. Meanwhile, Charlotte and Maze have differing ideas for Chloe's party and after a wild night, Chloe rethinks a life-changing decision.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي تأخذ إجازة، فيضطر لوسيفر إلى العمل مع دان على جريمة قتل تخص مسابقة كلاب.

episodes.name: Quintessential Deckerstar
episodes.overviewEn: When Lucifer and Chloe investigate the death of a woman, they discover that they may be pursuing the wrong suspect. Then, Charlotte risks her safety when she decides to take matters into her own hands.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يحققان في موت امرأة، ويكتشفان أنهما ربما يطاردان قاتلاً متسلسلاً قديماً.

episodes.name: A Devil of My Word
episodes.overviewEn: Shocked by someone's death, Chloe, Lucifer and the rest of the team work together to investigate and take down the killer. Then, Lucifer has an epiphany, Maze decides to mend a broken friendship and Chloe finally sees the truth.
episodes.overviewAr: الفريق مصدوم بموت أحد أفراده، ويعمل معاً لكشف القاتل. ختام القصة الرئيسية للموسم.

episodes.name: Boo Normal
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and the team investigate the murder of a child psychiatrist, while Ella thinks about a big childhood secret that she's been hiding.
episodes.overviewAr: حلقة إضافية: لوسيفر والفريق يحققون في مقتل طبيبة نفسية للأطفال، وإيلا تفكر في تغيير كبير.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer's dad creates an alternate dimension in which Lucifer now lives in a world where he not only has never met Chloe, but is granted the freedom of choice.
episodes.overviewAr: حلقة إضافية تتخيّل واقعاً بديلاً لم تجمع فيه الظروف نفسها بين لوسيفر وكلوي.

episodes.name: Everything's Okay
episodes.overviewEn: While investigating a beekeeper's murder with Lucifer, Chloe insists that she's completely fine with his devilish revelation, thank you very much.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي تعود بعد غياب وتصرّ على أنها متقبّلة تماماً لحقيقة لوسيفر، وهما يحققان في مقتل مربّي نحل.

episodes.name: Somebody's Been Reading Dante's Inferno
episodes.overviewEn: Chloe and Lucifer look into a murder on the set of a reality show. Father Kinley presses forward with a plan. Amenadiel reconsiders his idea of home.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي ولوسيفر يحققان في جريمة قتل في موقع تصوير برنامج واقع، ورجل دين يمضي في خطته بشأن لوسيفر.

episodes.name: O, Ye of Little Faith, Father
episodes.overviewEn: An ex-gang member's murder may mask an even darker crime. Lucifer catches Chloe in a lie. Dan and Maze go rogue. Linda braces for looming motherhood.
episodes.overviewAr: مقتل عضو سابق في عصابة قد يخفي جريمة أبشع، ولوسيفر يضبط كلوي في كذبة.

episodes.name: All About Eve
episodes.overviewEn: When a jewelry designer is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe strive to solve the case without each other's help. Also, Lucifer reconnects with an old flame.
episodes.overviewAr: مصمّمة مجوهرات تُقتل، ولوسيفر وكلوي يحاولان حل القضية كل بمفرده. وامرأة من ماضي لوسيفر البعيد تظهر: إيف.

episodes.name: Expire Erect
episodes.overviewEn: After a collector of classic cars is killed, Lucifer and Chloe search for the culprit -- as well as some closure to their relationship.
episodes.overviewAr: جامع سيارات قديمة يُقتل، ولوسيفر وكلوي يبحثان عن القاتل، وعن طريقة للعمل معاً من جديد.

episodes.name: Orgy Pants to Work
episodes.overviewEn: While Lucifer and Chloe search for a connection between a murdered auditor and a nudist colony, Amenadiel plays host to an unexpected visitor.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يبحثان عن صلة بين مدقق حسابات قتيل وتجمّع غريب، وأمينادييل يساعد شاباً في ورطة.

episodes.name: Devil Is as Devil Does
episodes.overviewEn: Eve takes a more active role in her main man's professional life. Meanwhile, Lucifer gets back to basics and Amenadiel fights for his family.
episodes.overviewAr: إيف تشارك أكثر في حياة لوسيفر المهنية، ولوسيفر يعود إلى عادة قديمة: معاقبة المذنبين.

episodes.name: Super Bad Boyfriend
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a teacher's murder. Meanwhile, Lucifer goes to extremes to convince Eve to dump him, and Amenadiel mentors a teen.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يحققان في مقتل معلّم، ولوسيفر يبالغ في محاولاته لدفع إيف إلى تركه.

episodes.name: Save Lucifer
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer's so-called epiphany has Chloe worried, but it's his physical transformation that's really freaking her out. Also, Maze gives Eve a pep talk.
episodes.overviewAr: ما يسمّيه لوسيفر «صحوته» يقلق كلوي، لكن التحوّل الذي يطرأ على هيئته هو المخيف حقاً.

episodes.name: Who's da New King of Hell?
episodes.overviewEn: With murderous demons on the loose in Los Angeles, it's up to Lucifer to reign in the chaos and protect the people he most cares about.
episodes.overviewAr: شياطين قتلة طلقاء في لوس أنجلوس، وعلى لوسيفر كبح الفوضى وحماية من يحبهم. ختام الموسم الرابع.

episodes.name: Really Sad Devil Guy
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer toys with a murder victim while Chloe and Maze investigate the death. Meanwhile, Amenadiel cleans up the club, and Linda mothers a genius.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر في العالم السفلي يلتقي ضحية جريمة، وكلوي وميز تحققان فيها على الأرض.

episodes.name: Lucifer! Lucifer! Lucifer!
episodes.overviewEn: After spending an eternity in hell, Lucifer returns to the land of the living - but there's something a little different about this handsome devil.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يعود إلى عالم الأحياء، لكن شيئاً فيه يبدو مختلفاً، وكلوي تلاحظ.

episodes.name: ¡Diablo!
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer - the real one this time - helps Chloe investigate a murder committed on the set of a TV show inspired by his own life.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر، الحقيقي هذه المرة، يساعد كلوي في جريمة قتل وقعت في موقع تصوير مسلسل مستوحى منه.

episodes.name: It Never Ends Well for the Chicken
episodes.overviewEn: The year is 1946. The world is black and white. And Lucifer is the star of his own noir detective story featuring familiar characters in new roles.
episodes.overviewAr: العام 1946 والعالم بالأبيض والأسود: لوسيفر يروي قضية قديمة حلّها على طريقة أفلام المحققين.

episodes.name: Detective Amenadiel
episodes.overviewEn: Amenadiel helps Chloe investigate a nun's untimely demise. Meanwhile, Lucifer lends Dan a hand, and Linda reveals a painful part of her history.
episodes.overviewAr: أمينادييل يساعد كلوي في التحقيق بوفاة راهبة، ولوسيفر يمدّ يد العون لدان.

episodes.name: BlueBallz
episodes.overviewEn: After a popular DJ is electrocuted on stage, Chloe searches for the killer while Lucifer tries to keep his jealousy over an ex-flame in check.
episodes.overviewAr: منسّق موسيقى مشهور يُصعق على المسرح، وكلوي تبحث عن القاتل ولوسيفر يحاول ضبط نفسه.

episodes.name: Our Mojo
episodes.overviewEn: As a shocking side effect of his romance with Chloe throws Lucifer for a loop, the new couple pursues a murderer with a most unusual M.O.
episodes.overviewAr: أثر جانبي صادم لعلاقته بكلوي يربك لوسيفر، وهما يطاردان قاتلاً متسلسلاً.

episodes.name: Spoiler Alert
episodes.overviewEn: Chloe learns a serial killer may have embellished his crimes. Amenadiel worries about his son's health. Pete opens up to Ella.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي تعرف أن قاتلاً متسلسلاً ربما بالغ في جرائمه، وأمينادييل قلق على صحة ابنه.

episodes.name: Family Dinner
episodes.overviewEn: Chloe and Ella investigate a mini-golf murder. Lucifer, Michael, Amenadiel and Linda prepare for the holiest of family dinners.
episodes.overviewAr: كلوي وإيلا تحققان في جريمة قتل في ملعب غولف مصغّر، والعائلة كلها تستعد لعشاء مع الأب.

episodes.name: Bloody Celestial Karaoke Jam
episodes.overviewEn: It's a musical? Yep, it's a musical. Lucifer, Chloe and the gang sing and dance to a slew of popular tunes while investigating a referee's murder.
episodes.overviewAr: حلقة غنائية: لوسيفر وكلوي والبقية يغنّون ويرقصون وهم يحققون في مقتل حكم رياضي.

episodes.name: Resting Devil Face
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer's father — you know, God — decides to experience life as a regular human. Meanwhile, a boxer dies under mysterious circumstances.
episodes.overviewAr: والد لوسيفر يقرر تجربة الحياة كإنسان عادي، وملاكم يُقتل قبل نزال مهم.

episodes.name: Daniel Espinoza: Naked and Afraid
episodes.overviewEn: A straightforward prisoner transport job turns into an increasingly dangerous, yet oddly invigorating, odyssey for Dan.
episodes.overviewAr: مهمة بسيطة لنقل سجين تتحول عند دان إلى مغامرة تزداد خطراً، ومتعة غريبة.

episodes.name: A Little Harmless Stalking
episodes.overviewEn: Linda throws herself into a deeply personal mission. Maze unmasks a blast from the past. Amenadiel ponders a new job.
episodes.overviewAr: ليندا تنغمس في مهمة شخصية جداً، وميز تكشف وجهاً من ماضيها.

episodes.name: Nothing Lasts Forever
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer angles to be his father's successor. Ella makes a painful confession. Chloe investigates a murder at an aquarium.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يسعى ليخلف والده، وإيلا تبوح باعتراف مؤلم، وكلوي تحقق في جريمة قتل.

episodes.name: Is This Really How It's Going to End?!
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer learns that not all of his siblings want him to land the big promotion. Also, Dan offers to set Ella up with an old friend.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يعرف أن إخوته ليسوا كلهم راغبين في فوزه، والفريق يتعرض لخسارة موجعة.

episodes.name: A Chance at a Happy Ending
episodes.overviewEn: The end is nigh! Lucifer, Chloe, Maze and Amenadiel prepare for battle with Michael and his not-so-angelic army of supporters.
episodes.overviewAr: النهاية تقترب: لوسيفر وكلوي وميز وأمينادييل يستعدون للمعركة مع مايكل وأتباعه. ختام الموسم الخامس.

episodes.name: Nothing Ever Changes Around Here
episodes.overviewEn: Before Lucifer starts his new job, he and Chloe experience a magical night with a murderous end. Linda and Amenadiel host Maze and Eve for dinner.
episodes.overviewAr: قبل أن يبدأ عمله الجديد، يعيش لوسيفر وكلوي ليلة ساحرة تنتهي بجريمة قتل.

episodes.name: Buckets of Baggage
episodes.overviewEn: Desperate to be helpful, Lucifer assists an exasperated Carol investigate a drag queen's death. Ella and Chloe look into Carol’s mysterious background.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر، المتلهف ليكون نافعاً، يساعد محققاً منزعجاً في قضية موت فنان استعراضي.

episodes.name: Yabba Dabba Do Me
episodes.overviewEn: Loony Lucifer and cartoon Chloe find themselves trapped in an animated loop. Amenadiel prepares for his new job. Dan returns to the city of angels.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر وكلوي يعلقان في حلقة متكررة داخل عالم رسوم متحركة.

episodes.name: Pin the Tail on the Daddy
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer reconnects with a few former flames in hopes of disproving Rory's claim. Dan tries to find someone — anyone — who can actually see him.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يتواصل مع صديقات سابقات أملاً في دحض ما تدّعيه روري، ودان يبحث عن خلاصه.

episodes.name: The Murder of Lucifer Morningstar
episodes.overviewEn: Not believing that he could have abandoned his future daughter, Lucifer sets out to prove an alternate theory: He must have been murdered.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر لا يصدّق أنه قد يتخلى عن ابنته في المستقبل، فيحاول إثبات تفسير آخر: أن أحداً سيقتله.

episodes.name: A Lot Dirtier Than That
episodes.overviewEn: Wanting to do well on his first day with the LAPD, Amenadiel crosses paths with a racist detective from his past. Also, Lucifer tries to bond with Rory.
episodes.overviewAr: أمينادييل في يومه الأول مع الشرطة يصطدم بمحقق عنصري.

episodes.name: My Best Fiend's Wedding
episodes.overviewEn: Just as Eve and Maze's wedding day arrives, Eve's ex, Adam — yes, that Adam — shows up hoping to reconcile. Later, Ella delivers some distressing news.
episodes.overviewAr: يوم زفاف إيف وميز يحلّ، ويظهر زوج إيف السابق آملاً في استعادتها.

episodes.name: Save the Devil, Save the World
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer says he's finally ready to be God, but his non-functioning wings would tend to disagree. Linda reluctantly shares the first draft of her book.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يقول إنه جاهز أخيراً لمنصبه، لكن جناحيه المعطّلين يقولان غير ذلك.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Lucifer
episodes.overviewEn: Lucifer tries to enjoy what may be his last day on Earth, Dan's killer escapes from prison, and Chloe drops a serious bombshell.
episodes.overviewAr: لوسيفر يحاول الاستمتاع بما قد يكون آخر أيامه على الأرض، وقاتل دان يهرب من السجن.

episodes.name: Partners 'Til the End
episodes.overviewEn: Desperate to rescue Rory, Lucifer and Chloe confront her kidnapper with guns and wings blazing. Lucifer finally comes to terms with his purpose.
episodes.overviewAr: لإنقاذ روري، يواجه لوسيفر وكلوي خاطفها بكل ما يملكان. الحلقة الأخيرة من المسلسل.
